_note: Identity homography: the SoccerTrack ground-truth halves under model/validation/soccertrack/ are ALREADY in pitch metres, so there is nothing to project. This is validate.METRE_CAL on disk, so build_match can be run against a real 45-minute half without a venue calibration. rms_error_m is 0.0 because the projection is exact by construction - that is a property of the fixture, NOT evidence that any real calibration is this good.
